excerpt: Table 1 reports loop-analysis precision over MRTC, DSPStone, MediaBench/MiBench, UTDSP, and miscellaneous benchmarks. The total row covers 96 benchmarks and 707 loops, with 99% analyzable loops and 96% exact loop iteration counts.
overview: This table is the strongest quantitative evidence for the automatic flow-fact claim. It demonstrates broad benchmark coverage and distinguishes safe analyzability from exactness, while also showing that remaining imprecision is limited to a small minority of loops.
title: Loop Precision Table
